topPRs.title: eth/064: Swell Mainnet L2 ProxyAdmin transfer to aliased AltLayer Safe
topPRs.author: ZakAyesh
topPRs.body:
## Description

Adds `eth/064-swell-l2pao-transfer`, executing the L2 half of the approved [Maintenance Upgrade Proposal: Swell Ownership Transfer to AltLayer](https://vote.optimism.io/proposals/55157120062626112833592164692393784963640643805353175342472662837980214398880) for Swell Mainnet (chainId 1923).

Using the `TransferL2PAOFromL1` template, the task sends a deposit transaction through the Swell OptimismPortal (`0x758E0EE66102816F5C3Ec9ECc1188860fbb87812`) calling `transferOwnership` on the L2 ProxyAdmin predeploy (`0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000018`), moving it from the aliased current L1PAO (`0x6B1BAE59D09fCcbdDB6C6cceb07B7279367C4E3b`) to the aliased AltLayer Safe:

```
alias(0xa83F1334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a8Dfa) = 0xb9501334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a9F0b
```

## Notes for reviewers

- **Stacked after `eth/063-swell-l1-ownership-transfers`** (PR #1511): the template asserts the L1 ProxyAdmin owner already equals the unaliased new owner, so a `stateOverrides` entry pre-applies the eth/063 transfer for standalone simulation. eth/063 must merge and execute first.
- Safe nonce overrides are pinned at live values (read 2026-07-30: L1PAO=36 / FUS=62 / SC=60) **+3**, accounting for the READY-TO-SIGN `eth/061` and `eth/062` tasks plus `eth/063`. If those are reordered or cancelled, the hashes must be regenerated.
- Swell was removed from the superchain-registry, so addresses load via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`, copied from the registry commit immediately before removal and verified on-chain.
- Simulated successfully on both child-safe legs (`foundation`, `council`) and via stacked simulation through this task, with the repo-pinned forge 1.1.0; VALIDATION.md hashes come from those runs.
- Swell's public RPC (`https://swell-mainnet.alt.technology`) now requires auth, so the L2-side deposit simulation per `docs/simulate-l2-ownership-transfer.md` needs an endpoint from AltLayer; post-execution verification can also use https://explorer.swellnetwork.io.

Part of ethereum-optimism/solutions#980.

topPRs.title: eth/063: Swell Mainnet L1 ownership transfer to AltLayer
topPRs.author: ZakAyesh
topPRs.body:
## Description

Adds `eth/063-swell-l1-ownership-transfers`, executing the L1 half of the approved [Maintenance Upgrade Proposal: Swell Ownership Transfer to AltLayer](https://vote.optimism.io/proposals/55157120062626112833592164692393784963640643805353175342472662837980214398880) for Swell Mainnet (chainId 1923).

Using the `TransferOwners` template, the task transfers from the standard mainnet L1PAO Safe (`0x5a0Aae59D09fccBdDb6C6CcEB07B7279367C3d2A`) to AltLayer's Safe (`0xa83F1334c6a8Daca576Dc14020d9d2b1b16a8Dfa`, confirmed by AltLayer in #oplabs-altlayer — a 1-of-1 Safe with sole member `0x6967D304E9b7E26b5eb3f5A1FD1239DaAD3215E6`):

- ProxyAdmin (`0x4C4710a4Ec3F514A492CC6460818C4A6A6269dd6`) — `transferOwnership`
- DisputeGameFactoryProxy (`0x87690676786cDc8cCA75A472e483AF7C8F2f0F57`) — `transferOwnership` (part of the `TransferOwners` batch, matching precedent `eth/014` / `sep/097`)

Swell's DelayedWETH is v1.5.0 (post-U16) and not ownable, so the template skips it.

## Notes for reviewers

- Swell was removed from the superchain-registry ("Remove Arena-Z and Swell (sunsetting chains)"), so addresses load via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`. Values were copied from the registry commit immediately before removal and verified on-chain.
- Safe nonce overrides are pinned at live values (read 2026-07-30: L1PAO=36 / FUS=62 / SC=60) **+2**, accounting for the READY-TO-SIGN `eth/061` and `eth/062` tasks signed by the same nested L1PAO. If those are reordered or cancelled, the hashes must be regenerated.
- Simulated successfully on both child-safe legs (`foundation`, `council`) with the repo-pinned forge 1.1.0; VALIDATION.md hashes come from those runs.
- Follow-up: the L2 ProxyAdmin transfer (`eth/064-swell-l2pao-transfer`) is submitted as a separate PR and stacks after this task.

Part of ethereum-optimism/solutions#980.

topPRs.title: template: tolerate SystemConfig 4.0.0 batchInbox removal in OPCMUpgradeV800
topPRs.author: mds1
topPRs.body:
Prepares `OPCMUpgradeV800` for SystemConfig 4.0.0 (op-contracts v8.0.0), which removes the `batchInbox()` getter and clears the legacy batch inbox slot during reinitialization (https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21641).

Changes:

1. The template's dev-HACK block read `sysCfg.batchInbox()` to build the code-exception whitelist. That getter call now goes through a tolerant staticcall: against SystemConfig 3.14.x it behaves as before, against 4.0.0 the missing selector reverts with empty return data and resolves to `address(0)`, which is filtered out (the reinit writes zero to that slot, which needs no code exception). Any other failure — a revert with data — surfaces loudly via `require` instead of being mistaken for the post-removal case.
2. Removed `batchInbox()` from the `ISystemConfigV800` interface, and applied the same tolerant read to the `SuperRootMigrate` integration test, which called the removed member.

Worth noting for U20 validation: `AccountAccessParser` labels SystemConfig slots by their keccak values, so the two slot-clearing writes (`Batch inbox address` → `0x0`, start block → `0x0`) will show up correctly labeled in every chain's state diff. That is the expected diff, per https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21641.

`OPCMUpgradeV700` also reads `batchInbox()`, but only ever runs against pre-4.0.0 SystemConfigs, so it is untouched.

Related PRs: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21641 (contracts), https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/922 (spec), the dev-docs edit rides along in the monorepo PR. Context: ethereum-optimism/optimism#21614.

topPRs.title: eth/062: remove key-control-proof signing gate
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## What

- Removes **signing gate 4 (key-control proof)** from the `eth/062-ink-fee-vault-recipient-update` README, along with the now-dangling "key control must be proven before signing (see below)" forward reference in the cost-recipient provenance note.
- Also removes **signing gate 1 (template dependency)** — satisfied since [#1504](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1504) merged (added via an accepted review suggestion from @matthew; the description originally said gates 1–3 were untouched, now corrected).
- Annotates the two remaining gates with live status as of 2026-07-29:
  - **Governance: cleared.** [Forum proposal](https://gov.optimism.io/t/maintenance-upgrade-proposal-ink-mainnet-fee-vault-config-update-and-proposer-rotation/10776) submitted 2026-07-22; the [Agora optimistic-approval vote](https://vote.optimism.io/proposals/98596515698156453044551125843803184999481750957062514239597457651661195220288) SUCCEEDED — veto window ended 2026-07-28 with 0.2% against vs the 20% quorum.
  - **Ordering: holds as planned.** Live L1PAO/FUS/SC nonces are 36/62/60 (expected pre-061 values); the pins (37/63/61) deliberately anticipate `eth/061` executing first.

## Why

Requested by matthew in the 061/062 signing-ceremony thread: signers walking the checklist (including assistant-driven walkthroughs) stall on gates that are satisfied, stale, or misread as drift.

## Note for reviewers

For an informed decision on the gate-4 removal, the facts as of 2026-07-29:

- `0x1eB630b2e7409597D462dd5f3D21E305FC56B8C9` remains **unused on L1** (nonce 0, balance 0, no code). No key-control proof (dust tx or signed message) has been produced yet.
- The k8s manifest is the *source* of the address, so its presence there confirms config consistency but not key control.
- Merging this removes the requirement to demonstrate control of the KMS key (`ink-mainnet-0/cost-recipient`) before the ceremony signs. A wrong/uncontrolled recipient after execution is only recoverable via another full nested-L1PAO task.
- Alternative that was considered: keep the gate and clear it with an op-signer signed message verified via `cast wallet verify`, annotated in the README.
